```{r}
#sunburst plot to show assay type, model system, and gene combinations

library(ggsci)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(reticulate)
library(ggrepel)

npg_colors_extended <- c(

curation = read.csv("~/Downloads/MAVE_curation_v3_figures.csv")

pillar_project_datasets = c('BRCA1_Findlay_2018', 'BRCA2_Hu_2024', 'VHL_Buckley_2024',
       'JAG1_Gilbert_2024', 'BRCA2_Sahu_2023_exon13_SGE',
       'BRCA2_Sahu_2023_exon13_Cisplatin_Resistance',
       'BRCA2_Sahu_2023_exon13_Olaparib_Resistance', 'BARD1_IGVF',
       'PALB2_IGVF', 'XRCC2_IGVF', 'SFPQ_IGVF',
       'BRCA2_IGVF', 'RAD51D_IGVF', 'CTCF_IGVF',
       'BAP1_Waters_2024', 'DDX3X_Radford_2023',
       'RHO_Wan_2019', 'RAD51C_Olvera-León_2024',
       'BRCA2_Sahu_2025_SGE', 'BRCA2_Sahu_2023_exon13_global_score',
       'FKRP_Ma_2024', 'LARGE1_Ma_2024',
       'CARD11_Meitlis_2020_SGE_Ibrutinib_GoF',
       'CARD11_Meitlis_2020_SGE_LoF',
       'ASPA_Grønbæk-Thygesen_2024_abundance',
       'ASPA_Grønbæk-Thygesen_2024_toxicity',
       'BRCA1_Adamovich_2022_Cisplatin_Resistance', 'BRCA1_Adamovich_2022_HDR',
       'CALM1_CALM2_CALM3_Weile_2017', 'CBS_Sun_2020_high_B6',
       'CBS_Sun_2020_low_B6', 'CHEK2_Gebbia_2024', 'CRX_Shepherdson_2024',
       'F9_Popp_2025_carboxy_F9_specific',
       'F9_Popp_2025_carboxy_gla_motif', 'F9_Popp_2025_heavy_chain',
       'F9_Popp_2025_light_chain', 'F9_Popp_2025_model',
       'F9_Popp_2025_strep_2', 'G6PD_IGVF',
       'GCK_Gersing_2023_complementation', 'GCK_Gersing_2024_abundance',
       'HMBS_van_Loggerenberg_2023_combined',
       'HMBS_van_Loggerenberg_2023_erythroid',
       'HMBS_van_Loggerenberg_2023_ubquitous',
       'KCNE1_Muhammad_2024_trafficking',
       'KCNE1_Muhammad_2024_potassium_flux',
       'KCNE1_Muhammad_2024_trafficking_WT_background_DN', 'KCNH2_Jiang_2022',
       'KCNH2_Kozek_Glazer_2020', 'KCNH2_O_Neill_2024_surface_expression',
       'MSH2_Jia_2021', 'NDUFAF6_Sung_2024', 'OTC_Lo_2023',
       'PAX6_McDonnell_2024_BLX_geneticin',
       'PAX6_McDonnell_2024_BLX_no_geneticin',
       'PAX6_McDonnell_2024_LE9_geneticin',
       'PAX6_McDonnell_2024_LE9_no_geneticin', 'PTEN_Matreyek_2018',
       'PTEN_Mighell_2018', 'SCN5A_Glazer_2020',
       'SCN5A_Ma_2024', 'SGCB_Li_2023',
       'TARDBP_Bolognesi_Faure_2019', 'TP53_Boettcher_2019',
       'TP53_Fayer_2021_meta', 'TP53_Fortuno_2021',
       'TP53_Giacomelli_2018_combined_score',
       'TP53_Giacomelli_2018_p53WT_Nutlin3',
       'TP53_Giacomelli_2018_p53null_Nutlin3',
       'TP53_Giacomelli_2018_p53null_etoposide', 'TP53_Kato_2003_AIP1nWT',
       'TP53_Kato_2003_BAXnWT', 'TP53_Kato_2003_GADD45nWT',
       'TP53_Kato_2003_MDM2nWT', 'TP53_Kato_2003_NOXAnWT',
       'TP53_Kato_2003_P53R2nWT', 'TP53_Kato_2003_WAF1nWT',
       'TP53_Kato_2003_h1433snWT', 'TPK1_Weile_2017',
       'TSC2_IGVF',
       'KCNQ4_Zheng_2022_current_homozygous',
       'KCNQ4_Zheng_2022_v12_homozygous')


curation <- curation[curation$Dataset_tag %in% pillar_project_datasets, ]

curation <- curation %>%
  filter(
    Assay.Type != "Not Applicable (trained predictor)",
    Disease != "None",
    Model_system != "Not Applicable"
  )

c <- curation %>%
  mutate(
    id_type   = paste0("type_", tolower(Disease)),
    id_assay  = paste0("assay_", tolower(Disease), "_", tolower(Assay.Type)),
    id_model  = paste0("model_", tolower(Disease), "_", tolower(Assay.Type), "_", tolower(Model_system)),
    id_gene   = paste0("gene_", tolower(Disease), "_", tolower(Assay.Type), "_", tolower(Model_system), "_", tolower(Gene..HGNC.symbol.))
  )

nodes <- bind_rows(
  # root: type of gene
  c %>% distinct(ids = id_type,  labels = tolower(Disease),            parents = ""),
  # assay types under type of gene
  c %>% distinct(ids = id_assay, labels = tolower(Assay.Type),         parents = id_type),
  # model system under assay type
  c %>% distinct(ids = id_model, labels = tolower(Model_system),       parents = id_assay),
  # gene under model system
  c %>% distinct(ids = id_gene,  labels = tolower(Gene..HGNC.symbol.), parents = id_model)
)

# sort genes alphabetically
nodes <- nodes %>%
  group_by(parents) %>%
  arrange(if_else(grepl("^gene_", ids), labels, ""), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

# make a disease → color map
disease_ids <- unique(nodes$ids[grepl("^type_", nodes$ids)])
color_map <- setNames(c("#F39B7FFF","#B09C85FF", "#00A087FF", "#3C5488FF")[seq_along(disease_ids)], disease_ids)

# assign colors by tracing back to the disease parent
nodes <- nodes %>%
  mutate(
    disease_parent = case_when(
      grepl("^type_", ids) ~ ids,
      TRUE ~ sub("^(type_[^_]+).*", "\\1", parents)  # pull disease id prefix
    ),
    color = color_map[disease_parent],
    labels = if_else(grepl("^type_", ids), "", labels) # hide disease labels
  )


# helper to wrap long text
wrap_label <- function(x, width = 12) {
  gsub(paste0("(.{1,", width, "})(\\s|$)"), "\\1<br>", x)
}

nodes <- nodes %>%
  mutate(
    labels = if_else(grepl("^model_", ids),
                     sapply(labels, wrap_label),  # wrap only model system labels
                     labels)
  )

# keep everything (don’t drop diseases; just hide labels)
fig <- plot_ly(nodes,
  ids = ~ids,
  labels = ~labels,
  parents = ~parents,
  type = "sunburst",
  branchvalues = "total",
  marker = list(colors = ~color),
  insidetextorientation = "radial"
)

fig

reticulate::py_module_available("plotly")

save_image(fig, "/Users/malvikatejura/Downloads/sunburst_updated_npg_colors.svg", width = 2000, height = 1600, scale = 2)
```

```{r}
#Figure 2C, variant effect measurements 

tested = read.csv("~/Downloads/var_effect_measurements_dataset.csv")

df2 <- tested %>%
  mutate(
    assay_type = case_when(
      SGE == "Yes"  ~ "SGE",
      Vamp == "Yes" ~ "VAMP",
      TRUE          ~ "Other"
    )
  )

summary_df <- df2 %>%
  group_by(Gene, assay_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_variants = sum(n_unique_IDs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


gene_order <- summary_df %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(n_variants)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  pull(Gene)

# Reorder Gene factor
summary_df <- summary_df %>%
  mutate(Gene = factor(Gene, levels = gene_order))

# Plot stacked bars in descending order
y = ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Gene, y = n_variants, fill = assay_type)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", color = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("SGE" = "#E57525",
               "VAMP" = "#09A3A3",
               "Other" = "grey") 
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Gene", y = "Total Variant effect measurements", fill = "Assay") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, face = 'italic'))

y

ggsave('~/Downloads/barplot_variants_npg_colors.png',y, dpi = 300, device = 'png', height = 4, width = 6)

#2C pie chart

igvf_summary <- tested %>%
  group_by(IGVF) %>%
  summarise(
    n_variants = sum(n_unique_IDs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

igvf_summary <- igvf_summary %>%
  mutate(
    pct = n_variants / sum(n_variants),
    label = scales::percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1)
  )


IGVF_pie = ggplot(igvf_summary, aes(x = "", y = n_variants, fill = IGVF)) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    width = 1,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  coord_polar("y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Yes" = "#176082",  
      "No"  = "#D6EAEC"  
    )
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = NA),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "black",
    size = 4
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(fill = "IGVF")

IGVF_pie

ggsave('~/Downloads/IGVF_pie_chart.png',IGVF_pie, dpi = 300, device = 'png', height = 4, width = 4)
```

```{r}

#venn diagram Figure 2D

venn = read.csv("~/Downloads/venn_counts_122225.csv")

# install.packages("eulerr")
library(eulerr)

# Collapse counts
B <- venn$count[venn$clnsig_group == "Benign"] +
     venn$count[venn$clnsig_group == "Likely benign"] +
     venn$count[venn$clnsig_group == "Benign/Likely benign"]

P <- venn$count[venn$clnsig_group == "Pathogenic"] +
     venn$count[venn$clnsig_group == "Likely pathogenic"] +
     venn$count[venn$clnsig_group == "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"]

G <- venn$count[venn$clnsig_group == "gnomad_total"]
D <- venn$count[venn$clnsig_group == "unseen_SNV"]

BG = venn$gnomad[venn$clnsig_group == "Benign"] +
          venn$gnomad[venn$clnsig_group == "Likely benign"] +
          venn$gnomad[venn$clnsig_group == "Benign/Likely benign"]

PG = venn$gnomad[venn$clnsig_group == "Pathogenic"] +
          venn$gnomad[venn$clnsig_group == "Likely pathogenic"] +
          venn$gnomad[venn$clnsig_group == "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"]

V = venn$count[venn$clnsig_group == "VUS total"]

VG = venn$gnomad[venn$clnsig_group == "VUS total"]

B_new = B - BG
P_new = P - PG
V_new = V - VG

B_new
P_new
V_new
G_new <- G - (BG+PG+VG)

B


#build Euler input call
fit <- euler(c(
  B    = B_new,
  P    = P_new,
  G    = G_new,
  D    = D,
  V    = V_new,
  "B&G" = BG,
  "P&G" = PG,
  "V&G" = VG
))

fit



sets <- unique(unlist(strsplit(names(fit$original), "&")))
sets

colors <- c("B"  = "#1D7AAB",
            "P"  = "#CA7682",
            "G"  = "#A5A9BE",
            "D"  = "white",
            "V" = "#545454")


#without labels 
x = plot(fit,
     fills = list(fill = colors[sets], alpha = 0.5),
     edges = list(col = "black"),
     labels = NA)


x

#with labels 
y = plot(
  fit,
  fills = list(fill =  colors[sets], alpha = 0.6),
  edges = list(col = "black"),
  labels = list(cex = 1.3, font = 2),
  quantities = list(cex = 0.9, font = 1)
)
y



ggsave('~/Downloads/venn_variants_updated.png',x, dpi = 300, device = 'png', height = 4, width = 4, bg =  "transparent")
```

```{r}
data = read.csv("~/Downloads/curation_summary_12172025.csv")

data_2 <- data[!duplicated(data$Gene), ]

sum(data_2$gene_test_count)

filtered_data <- data %>%
  distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

acmg_sf_genes <- c(
  "BRCA1",
  "BRCA2",
  "PTEN",
  "TP53",
  "MSH2",
  "PALB2",
  "RAD51C",
  "RAD51D",
  "CHEK2",
  "VHL",
  "TSC2",
  "F9",
  "SCN5A",
  "KCNH2",
  "KCNE1",
  "CALM1", "CALM2", "CALM3",
  "GCK",
  "JAG1"
)

length(acmg_sf_genes)

label_genes <- c("BRCA1",
  "BRCA2",
  "PTEN",
  "TP53",
  "MSH2",
  "PALB2",
  "RAD51C",
  "RAD51D",
  "CHEK2",
  "VHL",
  "TSC2",
  "F9",
  "SCN5A",
  "KCNH2", "CALM2", "CALM3",
  "GCK",
  "JAG1", "SCN5A","TARDBP","F9","RHO","TSC2","PALB2","G6PD","BARD1")



x <- ggplot(filtered_data,
       aes(x = gene_test_count, 
           y = possible_SNVs,
           size = Uncertain.significance,
           fill = IGVF_produced)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = ifelse(gene_symbol %in% acmg_sf_genes, "highlight", "normal")),
             shape = 21, alpha = 1, stroke = ifelse(filtered_data$gene_symbol %in% acmg_sf_genes, 1, 0)) +
  geom_text_repel(
  aes(label = ifelse(gene_symbol %in% label_genes, gene_symbol, NA)),
  size = 3,
  fontface = "italic",
  max.overlaps = 30,     # allow more labels
  box.padding = 0.7,      # more space around text
  point.padding = 0.6,    # more space around points
  force = 2,              # stronger repulsion between labels
  force_pull = 0.3,       # pull toward data point but not too tight
  segment.size = 0.2,     # thinner lines
  segment.color = "grey40",
  min.segment.length = 0  # always draw a line
) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Number of Clinical Tests",
       y = "Possible Number of SNVs",
       size = "Number of VUS in ClinVar (SNV)") +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "IGVF produced",
                    values = c("Yes" = "#176082","No" = "grey")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("highlight" = "red3", "normal" = 'black'),
                     guide = "none") +  # border colors
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1), "cm"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )


x

ggsave('~/Downloads/bubble_plot_only_pp_no_legend.png',x, dpi = 300, device = 'png', height = 5, width = 6)
```
